'''Tomax Bren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] of [[Scimitar assault wing]], an elite bomber unit.

==Biography==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Tomax Bren commanded the [[Scimitar assault wing]], a bomber formation attached to the [[Qeimet fleet]], created from six bomber squadrons to target [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] emplacements in the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]. The Scimitar wing earned the nickname "White Death", and was eventually credited with defeating the rebels in the sector despite their wide local support.<ref name="J15" />

During the [[Hook Nebula campaign]], Bren was known for his unorthodox methods, ignoring the initial guidelines on the deployment of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] and devoting an entire [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] - the [[Retribution (Imperial-class)|ISD ''Retribution'']] - to a supportive role in the Scimitar's assault missions. While these deviations would have normally resulted in [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]], they were overlooked due to the successes of him and his wing. It was commented that Bren had traded career advancements for his wing, but confidants knew that to fly and serve the Empire in the field was exactly what he wanted.<ref name="J15" />

Following the subjugation of the Hook Nebula sector, Bren wrote his post-campaign reports, which included recommendations for the then relatively new TIE bomber, recommendation for a carrier-based fleet due to his belief that the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was ascendant, and suggestions that future Star Destroyer models devote more room to hangar space. Notably, he pointed out several flaws in the TIE bomber's design and made a list of upgrade suggestions for a [[TIE Bomber Mark 2]]. Finally, he filed complete reports of his most effective tactics, such as the [[Vertical Swoop]] and the [[Coordinated Bombing-Landing]]. Though these tactics were disseminated, they were largely ignored by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] wings, but proved popular among [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] wings due to accounting for the planetary [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] problems they routinely encountered.<ref name="J15" />

[[File:Tomax_Bren-TIEBomber-XWM.png|left|thumb|Tomax Bren's TIE/sa bomber]]
Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Scimitar wing provided interference for evacuating ground troops. Later, Bren became one of the first commanders hand-picked by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to counterattack the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Grand Admiral had read the Hook Nebula reports and ordered the creation of the [[Scimitar assault bomber]] based on Bren's specifications.<ref name="J15" />

The newly equipped Scimitar Wing became a valuable asset during the [[Thrawn campaign]], and became instrumental in the assault on [[Mrisst]]. Following Thrawn's death, the Scimitar Wing was left under the command of Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="J15" />
